items.title: From Refugee Camps to Digital Threats, Third Committee Speakers Warn Rights under Strain amid Conflict, Displacement, Inequality
items.summary: Wars, displacement and rapidly evolving technologies are putting fundamental rights under mounting strain, delegates told the Third Committee (Social, Humanitarian and Cultural) today, spotlighting the plight of refugees and children caught in conflict, persistent discrimination against women and girls and new threats emerging in the digital sphere.
